integrity: Analytic reduction to ten finite short length profiles plus an omitted two-length-four profile excluded structurally; two independent standard-library programs reproduce the four optimal codebooks.
scientific_limitations: Only binary strong factor-free variable-length non-overlapping codes for three equiprobable messages; does not cover weaker cross-fix-free codes, other cardinalities, alphabets or nonuniform source probabilities; historical priority not independently certified.
title: Four optimal binary three-message variable-length non-overlapping codes
